title: Detecting Suicide Risk in Online Counseling Services: A Study in a Low-Resource Language

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model performance metrics (ROC-AUC, F2) in suicide risk detection across different age groups (10-17, 18-30, 31-64, 65+) to ensure consistent performance regardless of age-specific linguistic norms and vocabularies.

Evaluating and comparing model performance metrics (ROC-AUC, F2) across male and female help-seekers, specifically testing the model's robustness to Hebrew's heavily gendered morphological inflections.
